files.content: Selected direction: replace the retired helper with schema-v4 discovery. Record a small reusable Plan and finalize it.

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['TEAMWORK_CANDIDATE_ROOT'])
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/teamwork_index_v4.py'),'validate','docs/teamwork/index.json','--documents'],check=True)
index=json.loads(Path('docs/teamwork/index.json').read_text())
assert len(index['tasks'])==1
task=next(iter(index['tasks'].values()))
assert task['status']=='final'
assert task['documents'] and all(d['status']=='final' and d['type']=='plan' for d in task['documents'])
paths=[Path(d['path']) for d in task['documents']]
assert all(path.is_file() and path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() for path in paths)
